name: Metadata sweep: GCP + Azure + AWS in one primitive
goal: With one header-forwarding SSRF, sweep every major cloud's metadata service and harvest whichever identity plane the workload runs on.
preconditions: SSRF sink that forwards or allows injected request headers (needed for GCP Metadata-Flavor and Azure Metadata:true).
impact: GCP access tokens, Azure vmId/subscriptionId/IMDS tokens, or AWS credentials — whichever provider hosts the target.

steps.skill: web/SSRF GCP metadata instance zone read
steps.purpose: GCP check: metadata.google.internal with Metadata-Flavor: Google; projects/\d+/zones/ proves the identity plane.
AWS check: plain GET, no special header needed.
steps.on_success: Jump to chain aws-imds-full-takeover step 3 for the credential dump.
steps.on_fail: All three miss -> workload is on-prem or IMDSv2-only; sweep internal services via latency (see discovery.recon).

entry_points: any header-forwarding proxy or template renderer
fetch sinks where attacker controls some headers
CRLF-injectable parameters (inject Metadata-Flavor into the sub-request)

recon.name: Header passthrough test
recon.how: Send X-Test headers to your canary through the sink; if they arrive, metadata headers can be forged.

recon.name: CRLF header injection primer
recon.how: Probe parameters for %0d%0a to smuggle Metadata-Flavor into the internal request.
recon.signal: Injected header lands in internal request -> GCP/Azure metadata unlocks.

recon.name: Provider banner triangulation
recon.how: Error pages, Server headers and timing patterns reveal the hosting provider before you burn probes.
recon.signal: e.g. gstatic references, Azure App Service headers (x-ms-...), AWS ALB headers.

recon.name: Metadata IP alternatives
recon.signal: Any hit identifies the provider directly.

variants: k8s env-injected credentials instead of IMDS
pivot_hints: GCP token -> impersonate service accounts via token scopes
Azure IMDS -> managed-identity token -> ARM enumeration
record which provider answered to shorten future sweeps fleet-wide

sources: Azure IMDS protocol docs (version param required)
